description: Search file contents using a regular expression. Returns matching lines with file path and line number. Optimized for fast content search across all files. Optionally filter which files to search with a path glob.

path_filter.description: Glob pattern to limit which files are searched (e.g. /src/**)

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for (e.g. TODO|FIXME)

store.description: Named persistent store for cross-session access. Sessions are ephemeral (one per MCP connection); named stores persist indefinitely. Omit to use the session's own namespace.

name: grep
